left.message: $HOME/koan-root/tree/@Notes.md is not one of koan's names. koan only reports it: rename it without the @, or move it out.
$HOME/koan-root/tree/@work/@.tmp-9 is not one of koan's names. koan only reports it: rename it without the @, or move it out.
$HOME/koan-root/tree/@work/@1.md is named for @1, which is a folder, not a task. koan only reports it: rename it without the @, or move it out.
$HOME/koan-root/tree/@work/@api/@todo is not one of koan's names. koan only reports it: rename it without the @, or move it out.
